sourceMappingEvidence: Actual 48px runtime was inspected first and then visually matched by its functional subject to the complete high-resolution source board. Topic catalog independently corroborates identity. No alphabetical manifest slot inference was used.
functionalMotif: A circular rail-switch hub at the intersection of curved rail branches, cyan left-turn arrow and orange right arrow.
postprocessing: Exact source reference crop only. Generated artwork remains unchanged; no chroma key, alpha cleanup or pixel repainting.
sourceCropBasis: Visually verified full original card boundary on nonuniform board 02. Exact crops preserve all source card pixels without color or alpha edits.
legacyGridCropIssue: Uniform quarter-grid extraction does not match the actual card bounds. The toggle-bulkhead legacy crop includes a cyan sliver from the lower-row gravity card; this contamination survives as a horizontal bar beneath the original runtime. The switch-rail legacy crop starts below its true top edge and omits upper rail portions. The preserved complete-card reference, not the legacy crop, is used for generation.
